authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Don't add generic Thassa's Oracle/Consultation cEDH packages (source blueprint).
Don't treat it as generic Villain tribal or generic discard.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Discarding many lands at once is only one trigger.
Graveyard exile stops land recursion and Dakmor.
mitigations: Crucible still replays from hand discard cycles

blueprint_failure_modes.description: No Villain on board: no combat connive.

value.interaction: Counters (Swan Song, Fierce Guardianship) and removal; graveyard hate is a real threat.
value.mana: Many lands (fuel and mana); Treasure from Badgersaur/Bone Miser.
value.protection: Free protection; Doom is four mana.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Doom is the drain: every separate land-discard event is 2 from each opponent, and his combat connive filters toward more lands and Villain value.
accepted_role.honest_note: One trigger per discard event, not per land: mass discards (wheels) give one trigger. The kill is multi-piece and resource-dependent.
